2. A credit of $200 with a $50 refund issued against it, so that it is partly refunded. To issue a credit: click "Customers" in the top menu, open a customer, click the "Invoices" tab, click "Issue Credit", type the amount, choose "Issue Store Credit", type a short note and confirm. To refund part of it: on the credit's row, in the "Action" column, hover the icons and click the one whose tooltip reads "Cash Out"; the "Amount" box opens with the whole open balance already in it, so type the smaller figure you want to refund, choose a "Payment method", and click "Cash Out".
3. Separately, a credit that has been refunded in full - made exactly the same way, leaving the "Amount" box at the figure it opens with. Its "Status" then reads "Refunded".
